📢 NEW UPDATE: SWEET DREAMS 💤
Fall asleep and enter Dreamland! Jump across magical cloud platforms, collect glowing stars, and find the hidden Golden Pacifier. Your friends can even peek into your dreams and watch you play! Can you reach the Dream Fountain?

✨Welcome to Twilight Daycare!
⭐Please like and favourite the game!⭐ 

👶 Be a baby or a caretaker!
👪 Join a family!
🏡 Buy cool houses!
🧸 Play with cute toys!
👗 Dress up your avatar and create unique looks!
💬 Chat and hangout with friends!
💤 NEW: Fall asleep and enter Dreamland — a magical obby in the clouds! ☁️
📔 The Sticker Book is back, with brand new Pet Stickers! Open the Sticker Book near the Nursey in the Daycare and complete your collection! ✅
